title.narrative: Workplace Compliance through Labour Inspection Guidance and Social Dialogue (WPC)

description.narrative: The overall objective of the Project is to contribute to the creation of a more decent work environment for all women and men in Türkiye. The first objective of is to increase the capacity of the DoGI (Directorate of Guidance and Inspection) and social partners to increase workplace compliance. The second objective is to improve the workplace compliance through strengthening guidance services and awareness raising on decent work. The envisaged entity, ILO is a normative UN specialized agency with 187 member States and 101 years of experience in advancing international labour standards. Based on the principle of tripartism ¿ dialogue and cooperation between governments, employers and workers ¿ the ILO assists Member States and the social partners to realize rights at work, decent employment opportunities and social protection for all through social dialogue. ILO is the sole organisation of its kind and represents a monopoly in determining International Labour Standards (ILS).
